label: public-camera-thrust-response
label_source: Known-size measured gate pixels, public gyro, own sent commands. Raw acceleration only supplies stationary initial gravity; no native labels or fused p/v.
validation_rule: Six command levels, no parameter refit: future camera-position RMS<=0.12m, >=15% reduction from prior, each pulse RMS<=0.20m.
frozen_assumptions: Camera mount, image clock mapping, drag and instantaneous command model held fixed. Drag linearization uses only pre-pulse images and prior dynamics. Pulse grouping is the validation unit.
